mapper.select: SELECT * FROM deck ORDER BY tier, name
SELECT * FROM deck WHERE hidden_recommend = 1 ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO deck(name, tier, description, champion_ids, hidden_recommend) VALUES(#{name}, #{tier}, #{description}, #{championIds}, #{hiddenRecommend})
mapper.update: UPDATE deck SET name=#{name}, tier=#{tier}, description=#{description}, champion_ids=#{championIds}, hidden_recommend=#{hiddenRecommend} WHERE id=#{id}
